about.title: About Forsyth County Schools
about.content: Forsyth County Schools serves students in Forsyth County, Georgia, including Cumming and north metro Atlanta communities. The district's student calendar is useful for tracking first and last days, student/staff holidays, fall break, Thanksgiving break, Holiday Break, spring break, online learning and parent conference dates, professional development days when students do not attend, and early-release days.

about.title: How to Use the FCS Calendar
about.content: Use this page for districtwide student dates. Families should still check their assigned school for bell schedules, testing, athletics, performances, graduation events, transportation updates, and emergency schedule changes.

planningTips.title: Forsyth County Calendar Notes
content: FCS early-release days are not one-size-fits-all: elementary, middle, high school, and Alliance Academy dismissal times differ.
Online learning and parent conference dates are student calendar dates, but they do not follow a normal in-person school day.
Professional development dates are days when students do not attend while staff report.
Holiday Break is the late-December break; February student/staff holidays are listed separately and should not be assumed to match nearby districts.

districtFaqs.q: Which Forsyth County Schools calendar does this page summarize?
districtFaqs.a: This page summarizes official Forsyth County Schools student calendar PDFs for the listed school years.

districtFaqs.q: Are Forsyth County professional development days student holidays?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. When the FCS student calendar labels a professional development day as a student holiday, students do not attend school.

districtFaqs.q: Do early-release times differ by school level in Forsyth County Schools?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. FCS publishes different early-release times for Elementary I, Elementary II, middle schools, high schools, and Alliance Academy, so families should check the official calendar and their assigned school.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Forsyth County Schools calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Forsyth County Schools calendar page and the district PDF for final confirmation before making travel, child care, or school-specific plans.
